Top States by GST Collection

Source: R/collection.R
gst_top_states.Rd

Return the top n states ranked by total collection for a given period.

gst_top_states(
  n = 10L,
  component = "total",
  financial_year = NULL,
  from_month = NULL,
  to_month = NULL,
  exclude_other = TRUE
)

Arguments

n

integer. Number of states to return. Default 10L.

component

character(1). Component to rank by. Default "total".

financial_year

character vector. NULL = all years pooled.

from_month

character. Start month "YYYY-MM".

to_month

character. End month "YYYY-MM".

exclude_other

logical. Exclude non-state rows. Default TRUE.

Value

A data.table with columns rank, state, region, and the chosen component.

Examples

gst_top_states(n = 5, financial_year = "2023-24")
#>     rank       state region     total
#>    <int>      <char> <char>     <num>
#> 1:     1              Other 4036498.4
#> 2:     2 Maharashtra   West  320116.8
#> 3:     3   Karnataka  South  145265.9
#> 4:     4     Gujarat   West  125168.4
#> 5:     5  Tamil Nadu  South  121329.1
gst_top_states(component = "cgst", from_month = "2024-04", to_month = "2024-06")
#>      rank         state  region      cgst
#>     <int>        <char>  <char>     <num>
#>  1:     1                 Other 217763.44
#>  2:     2   Maharashtra    West  25800.40
#>  3:     3       Gujarat    West   9842.09
#>  4:     4     Karnataka   South   9557.85
#>  5:     5    Tamil Nadu   South   8604.95
#>  6:     6 Uttar Pradesh Central   7425.44
#>  7:     7   West Bengal    East   5323.91
#>  8:     8       Haryana   North   4706.99
#>  9:     9     Telangana   South   4203.55
#> 10:    10        Odisha    East   4094.46
